title: Pro Velo criticism of cycling promotion during the 2024 campaign
description: Shortly before the November 2024 election, the cycling-advocacy association Pro Velo Bern, through its president Michael Sutter (a former SP city parliamentarian), accused transport director Kruit of allowing cycling promotion to slow markedly and of the city not meeting its own standards from the cycle-infrastructure master plan, warning this endangered 'successful transport policy and climate protection'. Kruit firmly rejected the accusations, citing implemented measures (cycle streets, lanes, station bicycle parking) and the unchanged high priority of cycling. A Green Alliance city parliamentarian, Jelena Filipovic, also called the pace of expansion too slow.

title: Potential conflict of interest over Bernmobil electricity procurement
description: Reporting noted a potential conflict of interest in Kruit's dual role: as a Bernmobil board member she had an interest in cheap electricity, while as a city executive member she had obliged Bernmobil to buy electricity from Energie Wasser Bern. The executive's decision to relax that obligation was described as also removing this potential conflict.
